name: compliance-token
description: HTS compliance token with KYC, freeze and pause controls, a Chainlink-priced USD token sale, a did:hedera credential flow and an HCS audit log on Hedera. Hardhat contracts and a Next.js frontend.

steps.text: This template uses Hardhat and deploys a KYC/freeze/pause compliance token plus a Chainlink-priced USD sale to Hedera testnet, with Ed25519 investor credentials verified against a did:hedera issuer and an HCS audit log.

steps.label: Set up credentials (hidden prompts, nothing pasted into chat)
Fund your account with testnet HBAR
Deploy contracts, token, roles, audit topic and issuer DID
